Class Uri

java.lang.Object
com.radiantlogic.iddm.base.Uri

public abstract class Uri extends Object implements Comparable<Uri>

  • Method Details

    • fromString

      public static Uri fromString(@NonNull @NonNull String path)
      Create a new instance from the path.

      Throws an IllegalArgumentException if the path is not syntactically valid URI.

      Parameters:
      path - A valid URI path string.
      Returns:
      A new instance based on the specified path.

    • isOpaque

      public boolean isOpaque()
      Check for opaqueness of this URI.

      A URI is opaque if it is both an absolute path and does not start with a '/'.

      Returns:
      True if this URI is opaque, such as "file:/opt/foo/bar.json"

    • isAbsolute

      public boolean isAbsolute()
      Check for an absolute URI.

      A URI is absolute if it contains an explicit scheme component.

      Returns:
      True if this URI is absolute.

    • getUserInfo

      public String getUserInfo()
      Get the user information from this URI.
      Returns:
      The decoded user information from the authority. For example, for the authority "user@host:port", this method will return "user".

    • getAuthority

      public String getAuthority()
      Get the authority from this URI.
      Returns:
      The decoded authority portion of this URI. Example: "user@radiantlogic.com:443".

    • getQuery

      public String getQuery()
      Get the query portion of this URI.

      The query portion begins after the first question mark ('?') and is terminated by the number sign ('#') or the end of the URI.

      Returns:
      The decoded query portion of this URI.
